ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - AdvancedRun Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "AdvancedRun\.exe" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/EXEFilename\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Run.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/WindowState\\ 0.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/RunAs\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/CommandLine\\ .*")))
